# Browser runtime libraries

The web book vendors its small browser runtime so the local reader does not depend on a CDN or an install step.

| File | Package | Version | License |
|---|---|---:|---|
| `marked.esm.js` | Marked | 17.0.5 | MIT (`LICENSE.marked.md`) |
| `lucide.min.js` | Lucide | 1.8.0 | ISC (`LICENSE.lucide.txt`) |
| `mermaid.min.js` | Mermaid | 11.16.0 | MIT (`LICENSE.mermaid.txt`) |

When replacing a bundle, update this table and its corresponding license file in the same change.
